entity: LeConte Chapter of the Sierra Club
role: commenter on Draft Environmental Impact Statement
stance_basis: letter explicitly opposes project on multiple environmental, energy, and legal grounds, closing with emphatic opposition statement
summary: The LeConte Chapter of the Sierra Club, represented by member John J. Hagins, submitted detailed comments opposing the Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project, raising concerns about the saddle dike washout risk, wildlife and fishery impacts, energy waste inherent in pumped storage, failure to consider conservation alternatives, piecemeal environmental assessment of a larger development scheme, and inadequate treatment of cumulative impacts. The Chapter argued that the Final EIS must address the full scope of anticipated development to comply with NEPA and relevant court decisions, and the enclosed memo from a biologist member provided quantitative analysis of energy waste and stated emphatic opposition to the project.
complaint_summary: A follow-up letter from the Joseph LeConte Chapter of the Sierra Club transmits a previously omitted enclosure — a memo to Dr. L.L. Olmsted of Duke Power — that was referenced in the April 3 comment letter but never included, requesting it be considered as part of the Chapter's comments.

statement.text:
Recently you recieved a conv of comments concerning the Draft
Fivironmental Statement for the 3rd Creek Funned Stormen Development
Frought Do. 2200. In that copy of comments made on behalf of the
"Joseph JeConte Chanter of the Sierra Club I made reference to a
letter to Dr. L.L. Olmsted of Tube Bower Co. which intended to have\nincluded.
Unfortunately, a conv of that letter was never inserted, hence this letter. A copy of that letter is included in this letter and I would appreciate your consideration of it as part of the convents. Please have sure that it is included with my letter of the third of April.
Thank you were much for your cooperation and your attention.
Colm Flair
Joseph Leconte Chapter, Sierra Club
